newsitem.title: CHINA: APRIL's Riaupulp plans rupiah bond.
newsitem.headline: APRIL's Riaupulp plans rupiah bond.

text.p: Asia Pacific Resources Holdings (April) subsidiary PT Riau Andalan Pulp and Paper (Riaupulp) plans to raise US$300 million equivalent in rupiah bonds, finance director Michael Verge said on Wednesday.
He said the bond would have a maturity of five to seven years. Proceeds would be used in part to increase production of pulp to supply the company's Riaupaper project.
"We are expanding by 500,000 tons at Riaupulp to supply raw material for another project called Riaupaper and its 600,000 tons of paper production," he said.
PT Bahana Securities and PT Danereska Sekuritas have been mandated to arrange the bond issue, Verge said.
